title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem. 

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own: 

- Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).

- Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).

- Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.

- Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.

- Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.

- Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.

What You Bring: 

- 6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

- Expertise with a scripting language like Python.

- Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).

- Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).

- Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).

- Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.

- Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.

- Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming

- Experience with version control e.g. Git.

- Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.

- Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.

- Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.

- Experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Loki Query  | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time. 

Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Loki Query | EMEA | Remote 

The Opportunity: 

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics , Loki for logs , Tempo for traces , and Pyroscope for profiles . Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on Prometheus , Grafana Agent , Mimir proxies , and OpenTelemetry.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro).

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives 

- Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.

- Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers

- Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope

- Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability

- Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running

- Supporting other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team

- Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit: 

- You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action

- You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs 

- Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively

- Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must

Requirements: 

- Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well

- Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way

- Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering

- Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others

Bonus Points For: 

- Experience working with Kubernetes and/or Docker

title: Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - EMEA
description:
About Remote 

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. 

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. 

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! 

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

- Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.

- Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.

- Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.

- Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.

- Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.

- Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.

- Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.

- Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.

- Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.

- Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.

- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.

- Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.

- Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.

- Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

- Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.

- Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.

- Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.

- Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.

- Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.

- Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.

- Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.

- Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.

- Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.

- Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.

- Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency. 

Practicals

- You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions

- Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions

Application process

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

 Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

 Who you are - You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

- You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

- You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

- You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

- You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

- You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

 Your potential growth path: 

 - Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

- Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

- 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

 

 Your performance objectives 📣 Generate pipeline - Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

- Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

- Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

 💪 Close opportunities - Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

- Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

- Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

 💡 Build expertise - Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

- Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

 📈 Lead by example - Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

- Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

- Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

 

 🇪🇺 Your territory You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

   📍 Work location Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

   Whom you'll be working with - Clifton Lobo , VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

- Sebastian Schaal , Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

- Inga Schwarz , Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

- Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

- Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

 

 💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

 If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here .

 

 ⚡️ About Luminovo Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry . 

 We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. 

 We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain. 

 To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million .

 

 Our core principles: putting people first & building great things 

 As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

 Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

 We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

 About AMBOSS 

 AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

 Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

 
 Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

 

 Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

 You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

 This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

 

 Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

 

 You will: - Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

- Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

- Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

- Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

- Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

- Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

- Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

 

 You bring: - Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

- Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

- Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

- Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

- Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

- Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

- Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

 

 Nice to have: - Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

- Proficiency in German

- Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

- Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

- Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

- A Workday consulting or CoE background

- A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

 

 You enjoy: - Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

- Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

- Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

- Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

 

 What success looks like after your first year: - The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

- The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

- The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

- Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

 

 Benefits: 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

 🥙Food & Office Comfort ( Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

 Check out the full list of benefits below:

 https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

 Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

- Financial Mastery: Proven proficiency in project costing, budget management, scope estimation, and financial risk mitigation.

- Client-Facing Mindset: Genuinely enjoys being client-facing and comfortable serving as the day-to-day operational contact for high-level brand partners.

- Rigorous QC Standards: An exceptional eye for detail, proofreading, and linguistic/visual quality assurance for social content.

- Experience delivering marketing or social campaigns within film, streaming, TV, or broader entertainment media.

- Exposure to live-action shoot production logistics and modern AI-driven production workflows.

 Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

 Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

 The Creative Strategy & Content Manager works closely with strategists, creatives, media, data and AI specialists to ensure content is both culturally relevant and commercially effective. They’re confident using GenAI tools to support creation, iteration and testing, and balance strong creative judgment and quality control.

 

 Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Lead the delivery of content projects from brief creation through to final output, ensuring timelines and quality standards are met

- Provide clear direction and feedback to improve content quality and effectiveness

- Research and apply audience and cultural insights to content approaches and messaging frameworks

- Support content audits and identify opportunities to improve performance and consistency in outputs

- Translate cultural trends and data into clear creative direction

- Shape content strategies for campaigns and ongoing programmes

- Use GenAI tools such as Pencil to support content generation, iteration and testing

- Maintain content tracking, reporting and documentation, including editorial calendars and performance summaries

- Lead client conversations on content performance, recommendations and optimisation

- Identify opportunities to expand content scope and improve account performance

- Work closely with strategists, designers, media and data teams to deliver cohesive creative output

- Take feedback on board and apply it to improve both individual and team output

- Support onboarding and management of freelance creators

- Mentor junior team members, supporting their development in both craft and thinking

- Act as a connector between disciplines, ensuring strategy translates into execution

title: Technical Lead, Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy 

 Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

 Your Role 

 As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification , you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

 You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.

 

 What you’ll do - Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

- Ensure that the amplification architecture and development activities remain traceable to ICF system-level laser requirements.

- Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

- Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

- Deliver subsystem performance to agreed specifications for energy, gain, beam quality, pulse contrast, and reliability.

- Own the technical risk register, define mitigations and owners, and escalate risks early—before they become schedule or performance issues.

- Define maturity gates for key amplification subsystems and technologies, and drive focused development activities to close demonstration gaps.

- Own technical interfaces with adjacent functions, including Light Generation, Light Conditioning, Beam Transport, and Focusing.

- Represent Light Amplification in system-level design reviews and communicate decisions, progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to technical and leadership audiences.

- Build and develop the Amplification team by hiring engineers and scientists, setting clear expectations, providing feedback, and growing technical and leadership capability.

 Who You Are - A PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, photonics, or a closely related field.

- Demonstrated experience leading a technical team by setting direction, developing people, and maintaining effective communication across organizational boundaries.

- Hands-on experience with high-energy or high-power laser amplification systems, including solid-state, fiber, or diode-pumped architectures.

- Strong understanding of gain media physics, thermal effects, wavefront distortion, ASE, pulse contrast, and beam quality in amplifier chains.

- Experience taking a laser subsystem from concept through hardware delivery, characterization, and integration.

- The ability to own a technical scope, make decisions under uncertainty, and communicate clearly with both technical and leadership audiences.

- Experience working in a matrix organization with shared resources and cross-functional dependencies.

- A structured approach to requirements definition, traceability, risk management, root-cause analysis, and technical decision-making.

 Nice to have - Experience in an ICF, high-power laser facility, or defense laser program.

- Familiarity with amplification architectures.

- Experience with diode-pumped solid-state amplifiers at the joule scale or more.

- Experience with coaching, mentoring, performance management, hiring, onboarding, and team building.

- Experience applying systems engineering and design-for-cost or design-for-manufacturing methods in a complex hardware program.

 
 Why work with Us? - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

- Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us. What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title? Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact. That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us. 

 Why Tanso? - Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.
- Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.
- Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.
- Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.
- AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.
- Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.
 

 Your role To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a  Software Engineer (f/m/x).  

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. We care less about following a predefined playbook and more about making good decisions, moving with purpose, and building software that creates tangible value for our customers.

 Key responsibilities - Own customer-facing features from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
- Turn ambiguous requirements and user needs into pragmatic, maintainable solutions. Challenge assumptions and help decide what is worth building
- Collaborate closely with product designers and customer success to understand user needs and shape effective solutions.
- Contribute to the quality of our codebase, engineering practices, and developer experience.
 

 Your profile - You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software in Typescript.
- Strong full-stack and product thinking, understanding systems end-to-end.
- First experience with backend development, ideally with PostgreSQL and Azure.
- Clear, precise communicator in English. 
- Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.
 Nice to have - German language skills. 
 

 What we offer - A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. 
- Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
- A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. 
- Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. 
- Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. 
- Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. 
 

 Our team We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.

 Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

 What you will work on - Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
- Backend services in TypeScript.  The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
- Cloud infrastructure on GCP . Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
- Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.
 

 What Sets You Up for Success Must have: - At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
- Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
- Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
- Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
- Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
- You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
- Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
- Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
 Nice to have: - Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
- Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
- Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
- You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline
 

 What You Get - Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
- Competitive salary
- Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
- Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
- Wellpass membership
- Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
- Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.

 Why This Role Matters You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own: - The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
- The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
- The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
- Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
- Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend
 

 What You’ll Achieve - Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
- Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders.
- We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here
- Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow.
- Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again
- Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one
- Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints
 

 What Sets You Up for Success Must have 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads
- You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind
- You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after
- Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself
- You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call
- You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate
- Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand
 Nice to have - Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain.
- Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked).
 Not required - Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Was erwartet dich in dieser Position? 
Als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) betreust und entwickelst du die wichtigsten Apothekenpartnerschaften von Montu in ganz Deutschland. Du verantwortest ein strategisch relevantes Vertriebsgebiet, baust Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträger:innen weiter aus und steigerst die kommerzielle Performance durch strategische Beratung und eine konsequente Betreuung deiner Accounts.
Die Position ist dynamisch, eigenverantwortlich und ideal für jemanden, der Freude daran hat, Geschäftsbereiche aktiv aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln, anstatt bestehende Strukturen lediglich zu verwalten.

 Was sind deine Aufgaben? 
 Sales Growth 

 - Identifikation und Umsetzung von Upselling-, Cross-Selling- und Wachstumspotenzialen.

- Gewinnung neuer Accounts mit hohem Potenzial und Ausbau der Marktpräsenz von Montu.

- Unterstützung von Apotheken bei der Optimierung ihrer operativen Prozesse im Bereich medizinisches Cannabis.

 Account Management 

 - Betreuung und strategische Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios bedeutender Apotheken und Kliniken.

- Aufbau langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern und Entscheidungsträger:innen.

- Führung fundierter Gespräche über Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, Wachstumspotenziale und das Produktportfolio.

 Markt- & Geschäftsanalyse 

 - Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Marktentwicklungen.

- Weitergabe relevanter Marktkenntnisse und Kundenfeedbacks an das Sales Leadership Team zur Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Strategie.

- Sorgfältige Pflege des CRM-Systems sowie zuverlässiges Reporting relevanter KPIs.

 Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit 

 - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Inside Sales, Customer Service, Logistics und Compliance.

- Partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Medical- und Marketing-Teams bei Informations-, Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen.

- Teilnahme an relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen sowie professionelle Repräsentation von Montu.

 Außendienst 

 - Durchführung gezielter persönlicher Kundenbesuche mit Fokus auf qualitativ hochwertige und wirkungsorientierte Termine anstelle einer reinen Maximierung der Besuchsanzahl.

 Was bringst du mit? 

 - Berufserfahrung im Bereich Sales, Key Account Management oder Business Development.

- Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, in der Pharmaindustrie, Medizintechnik oder einer anderen regulierten Branche ist von Vorteil.

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, medizinische und therapeutische Informationen zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln.

- Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Erfahrung im Management einer vielfältigen Sales-Pipeline.

- Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

- Gültiger Führerschein.

 Warum Montu? 

 - Gestalte mit uns durch innovative Telemedizinlösungen die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung in Deutschland.

- Werde Teil eines internationalen Teams mit einer kollaborativen und flexiblen Arbeitskultur.

- Arbeite in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen, in dem deine Arbeit direkten und sichtbaren Einfluss hat.

- Profitiere von Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

 Your Profile 

 - Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Economics, Social Science, or related field preferred; Bachelor's with significant relevant experience considered

- Very good analytical / quantitative skills, a high degree of initiative and a high-quality standard 

- Good understanding of Microsoft 365 (esp. advanced Excel)

 What we offer 

 In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

 Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE 

 Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

   WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 

 - Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

- Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

- Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

 

 YOUR IMPACT 

 As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

 

 WHAT YOU WILL DO 

 - Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

- Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

- Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

- Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

- Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

 

 WHO YOU ARE 

 - A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

- Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

- Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

- Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

 

 INTERVIEW PROCESS 

 - Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Senior Analyst — Customer (Beauty)
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. 

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.

Why be a Senior Analyst — Customer (Beauty) at THG? 

As Senior Analyst in the Beauty Customer team, you will own analytical work that helps THG’s Beauty division understand and grow its customer base. Working across acquisition, retention, CRM, marketing and loyalty, you will build the analysis, models and insight that enable the business to make better decisions about how it acquires and retains customers. You are expected to work largely independently — owning complex analytical problems end-to-end.

As a Senior Analyst — Customer (Beauty) , you will: 

Customer Analytics 

- Own analytical projects across the customer lifecycle — acquisition, retention, CRM, loyalty, marketing performance and personalisation

- Build customer segmentations, cohort analyses and behavioural models that the business can act on

- Analyse marketing channel performance — understanding what drives efficient acquisition

- Support development of the Beauty customer KPI framework

- Contribute to marketing mix modelling (MMM) — providing customer and channel inputs, and connecting MMM outputs back to customer-level acquisition and retention decisions

- Synthesise quantitative data with qualitative insight (customer research, surveys, feedback) to build a rounded view of customer behaviour

Technical Delivery 

- Write and maintain SQL queries and analytical scripts — producing accurate, well-documented analysis

- Work with the Engineering team to understand the customer data model

- Build dashboards and reports that communicate customer performance clearly

Stakeholder Engagement 

- Present findings to the Customer Lead and Beauty stakeholders — translating complex analysis into clear business recommendations

- Manage ad hoc analytical requests — prioritising effectively and delivering reliably

- Coach the Customer Analyst — sharing knowledge and providing feedback

- Build strong working relationships across Beauty, Marketing, Brand and Data Engineering — managing stakeholder expectations and competing priorities proactively

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

Essential 

- Experience (typically 3+ years) in customer analytics, CRM or marketing analytics

- Strong SQL skills — comfortable building complex analytical queries

- Experience with customer segmentation, cohort analysis or lifecycle analytics

- Strong storytelling — able to communicate complex analysis clearly to non-technical stakeholders

- Proven ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership

- Experience with ecommerce analytics — conversion, funnel and site performance metrics

- Skilled at synthesising quantitative data with qualitative insight to form a complete view of customer behaviour

- Strong stakeholder management — able to build trust and manage competing priorities across functions

Desirable 

- Experience in beauty, lifestyle, fashion or e-commerce environments

- Exposure to marketing mix modelling (MMM) or econometric approaches to marketing measurement

- Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms

- Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tooling

What Good Looks Like at This Level 

At THG, we expect everyone to demonstrate behaviours that match their level. Here is what that looks like in this role:

- Operates largely independently — owns complex customer analytics end-to-end

- Deep expertise in customer analytics — the go-to person for customer behaviour, acquisition and retention questions

- Coaches the Customer Analyst — actively developing team capability

- Accountable for own targets — delivers high-quality analysis with minimal supervision

- Understands how customer analytics connects to commercial outcomes — CLV, retention rate, acquisition cost

- Makes pragmatic decisions on analytical approach — balancing rigour with speed

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

- Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.

- Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave 

- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.

- Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!

- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.

- Up to 10 days compassionate leave.

- Buy back up to 3 days each year.

- Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support 

- Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.

- Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.

- State-of-the-art on-site gym.

- Access to our on-site physio.

Other Perks 

- Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.

- Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.

- Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

- On-site staff shop.

- Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.

- Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability. 

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community. 

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

 THE ROLE 

 We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

 Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

 Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

 We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

 That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

 - Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

- Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

- Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

- Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

- Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems.

- Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better.

- Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t.

 - We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself.

- You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple.

- You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both.

- You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better.

- Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using.

 - A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference.

- We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real.

- Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most.

- The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers.

- Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without.

About the Role 

The Senior Manager, FP&A reports to the Chief Operating Officer and owns the financial planning and analysis function for a global business generating over $50M in revenue, with a growth trajectory toward $200M over the next 3 years. The role is the primary analytical partner to functional leaders and works in close partnership with strategic finance. It translates operating plans, pipeline, and headcount plans from Sales, RevOps, and People into controlled financial outputs, and explains performance against plan in terms leaders can act on. It owns the integrity of the company's planning models, and that ownership sets the boundary with strategic finance: deal origination, valuation, and financing analysis sit outside core FP&A, but every completed acquisition has to be absorbed into the operating plan, forecast, and reporting baseline this role owns. The two functions therefore work together from diligence onward rather than at handover, so that the assumptions underwriting a deal survive into the model the company plans against.

The Senior Manager, FP&A leads the FP&A team and is accountable for its output quality, its operating model, and its capacity to scale with the business. The role is expected to make FP&A AI-native: each planning and reporting cycle must become faster, more accurate, and better controlled through automation and AI-enabled workflows, within the systems and control framework that governs the wider finance function.

What You'll Bring 

- Forecasting and financial model architecture — Knowledge of driver-based forecasting, budgeting, scenario planning, investment analysis, and the design principles that keep a model auditable, maintainable, and able to absorb a new entity without being rebuilt. Applies this knowledge to build models that scale with the business through both organic growth and acquisition.

- Revenue, pipeline, and commission economics — Knowledge of bookings, recurring revenue, renewals, pipeline conversion, revenue recognition timing as it affects the forecast, and commission plan mechanics. Applies this knowledge to convert pipeline and contract data into a revenue forecast and commission forecast that hold up to scrutiny.

- Headcount, cost, and cash planning — Knowledge of personnel planning and costing, non-personnel opex, capex, cost allocation, and the FX exposure and entity-level cost flows that shape a multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction forecast. Applies this knowledge to build personnel and non-personnel budgets and a cash-flow forecast that reconcile to actuals.

- Management and board reporting — Knowledge of KPI design, variance analysis, management reporting structure, and the conventions of board and investor packs. Applies this knowledge to produce reporting that leadership plans against, with the analysis behind each number ready when challenged.

- FP&A systems, data, and automation — Knowledge of planning tools, data flows from finance, CRM, and HR systems, workflow automation, and AI-enabled analysis. Applies this knowledge to identify where manual effort and error enter the planning and reporting cycle and to select the tooling that removes them

What You'll Do 

- FP&A team leadership and operating model — Leads the FP&A team by owning model responsibilities, the planning calendar, review controls, documentation, data flows, hiring, coaching, and role design, so that the function scales while maintaining consistent output quality without dependency on any single analyst.

- Budgeting and re-forecasting — Owns the annual budget and re-forecast cadence end to end by establishing assumptions with functional leaders and translating Sales, RevOps, and People inputs into controlled pipeline-to-revenue bridges, personnel and non-personnel budgets, commission forecasts, opex, and capex, so that each planning cycle delivers a controlled financial baseline on the agreed calendar.

- Financial modelling, scenario analysis, and acquisition integration — Builds, maintains, and reviews the operating plan, forecast, cash-flow, scenario, and acquisition-integration models by testing model logic and sensitivities, reconciling deal assumptions to post-close actuals, and establishing the combined baseline for completed acquisitions, so that the company plans against maintainable models that preserve deal assumptions and show performance against the acquisition case.

- Management, board, and investor reporting — Drives the management reporting cycle and financial analysis for board and investor packs by translating variance to plan into operational drivers and stating the resulting implications for the forecast, so that leadership can use the reporting directly to make planning decisions.

- Planning process automation — Drives automation and AI-enabled workflows by redesigning data collection, plan consolidation, variance analysis, and report production and measuring changes in cycle time, error rate, and analyst hours, so that planning and reporting become faster and better controlled while analyst capacity shifts from data handling to analysis.

What We Offer 

- The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.

- A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.

- A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long-term value creation.

- Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid role (1 day in office). 

- A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance.

About Our Process 

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 

During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.

The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

- Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.
